mode_source: MCC_3_0_Full_Book_KO_v0.12.pdf, current version 2, pages 106–107. Electron-mode SI clock bridge; phase-resolution condition, not a universal shutter derivation.
source_geometry_status: Pages 13–14 define an abstract 15-channel common carrier and an internal compact-circle witness. Pages 149–150 distinguish internal slots from particles and records. None of these is used as an externally measured distance.
new_spatial_renderer: A separate finite 512-cell ring computational domain, one right shift per shutter on each of 15 internal channels, with dx=c*dt. This is a new conditional implementation and is not an identification of SOURCE arithmetic addresses with physical sites.
